decisions.reason: The _v19 suffix governs naming of newly delivered documents and does not change the required behavior when legacy content is copied into new templates.
Changing the delivery filename suffix does not alter bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, or coverage.
The naming instruction does not change the constraint that pasted content remain within page margins.
Using _v19 for newly sent filenames does not change the master template's role as the foundation for derived templates.
The document version suffix has no effect on numbered-list alignment behavior.
The filename suffix instruction does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The source changes document filename versioning, not the names, language, or prefix of styles inside the templates.
Naming delivered files with _v19 does not modify the specified style system or its application across templates.
The version suffix does not resolve or alter table and column layout requirements or their existing ambiguity.
The delivery naming change does not affect Tab-driven list transitions, hierarchy, alignment, or the existing workflow ambiguity.
The _v19 filename suffix does not change the supported Microsoft Word environment or operational reliability requirement.
The naming instruction for newly sent documents does not change interactive-field help text, labels, language, locations, or hover behavior.
